stories.title: NBA season preview: Rankings, predictions and what to know for all 30 teams
stories.summary: Here's everything you need to know for every team, including storylines, stats and predictions ahead of opening night.

stories.title: Source: Giants releasing Harris amid ongoing RB woes
stories.summary: The Giants are releasing running back Najee Harris, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport. Harris started Sunday's loss against the Saints but had just 2 yards on four carries.

stories.title: Dybantsa debut delayed: No. 1 pick out opener due to ankle
stories.summary: AJ Dybantsa, the No. 1 pick in the NBA draft, will miss the Wizards' season opener Wednesday because of an ankle injury.

stories.title: Titans abruptly release DT Elliott for undisclosed incident at facility
stories.summary: The Titans abruptly released defensive tackle Jordan Elliott on Tuesday, citing an undisclosed "incident" from Thursday at the team's facility.

stories.title: Nearly $1 million in trading cards stolen from FedEx truck in California
stories.summary: Police in California are investigating the theft of trading cards worth at least $963,000 that were taken from a FedEx truck parked outside of a company that verifies memorabilia.
